verses.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.sm: Iopu i le puupuu o lenei olaga, ma lona leaga O le tagata ua fanau mai i le fafine, ua saasaa ona aso, mona ua tumu i le atuatuvale.

verses.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.sm: E tupu ae o ia e pei o le fuga, a e salaeseina; e mavae atu foi o ia e pei o le ata, ma ua le tumau.

verses.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.sm: Se tagata faapena ea e silasila i ai ou fofoga, ma e au mai ia te au e faamasinoina faatasi ma oe?

verses.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.sm: Po o ai ea e au mai se mea mama nai le mea eleelea? e leai se tasi.

verses.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tuupoina ona aso; o loo ia te oe le faitau o ona masina; ua e tuuina lona tuaoi e le\sopoia e ia.

verses.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.sm: O lea ia e silasila ese ai ia te ia, ia tapu ai o ia, seia faaatoaina e ia lona aso e pei o le ua galue i le taui.

verses.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.sm: Auā a tā le laau, e faamoemoe i ai e toe tupu, e le aunoa foi ma ona tatupu.

verses.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.sm: E ui lava ina ua leva ona aa i le eleele, ma ua mate lona tafue i le eleele,

verses.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.sm: a e toe tupu ae i le susú o le vai, ma tutupu ona la, e pei o le laau tupu.

verses.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.sm: A o le tagata e oti o ia, ma taatia, e to fci le mánava a le tagata, ona ifea lea o ja?

verses.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.sm: E pe le suávai nai le vai, e mate foi le vaitafe, ma ua matutu.

verses.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.sm: E taoto foi le tagata a e le toe tulai, seia mavae le lagi, latou te le ala, e le fagua foi i latou i lo latou moe.

verses.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.sm: E! fia natia au e oe i le tuugamau ma ia e faaliloina au, seia mavae atu lou toasa; ia e atofaina mai se aso mo aʻu, ma ia e manatua mai ai aʻu.

verses.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.sm: Afaieoti le tagata, e toe ola mai ea o ia? Ou te faatalitali atu i aso uma o le taua ua tofia ai aʻu, seia oo ina suia O aʻu.

verses.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.sm: la e valaau mai, ona ou tali atu ai lea ia te oe: ia e finagalo alofa i le galuega 2 vu aao.

verses.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.sm: Aua ua e faitaulia nei oʻu laasaga, e le ua e lamalama ea i au agasala?

verses.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.sm: Ua faamaufaailogaina loʻu solitulafono i le taga, ma e faaopoopoina faatasi laʻu amioletonu.

verses.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.sm: E moni e mavae le mauga ua solo, e siitia foi le papa ai le mea sa iai.

verses.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.sm: E aia maa e le vai; e táfea e le lolo le eleele o le fanua; e te faaumatia foi le faamoemoe o le tagata.

verses.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.sm: zo E te manumalo pea lava ia te ia, e alu ese ai foi o ia; ua e liua ona mata, ona e awna atu ai lea o ia.

verses.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.sm: E oo ina mamalu ona atalii, a e le iloa e ia; e faaleaogaina foi i latou, a e le lagona ai e ia.

verses.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.sm: A e tigaina lona lava tino, ma faanoanoa lona lava loto. Ona tali mai ai lea o
